title: Shortest Impossible Sequence of Rolls
summary: Given an integer array representing dice rolls and the number of sides on the dice, find the shortest sequence of rolls that does not appear as a subsequence in the given rolls.
statement: Given an integer array representing dice rolls and the number of sides on the dice, find the shortest sequence of rolls that does not appear as a subsequence in the given rolls.
constraints: Roll values range from one through k.
Find the minimum length of a value sequence that is not a subsequence of rolls.
Return that minimum length, not the sequence itself.
hints: Scan rolls while collecting distinct faces in the current block.
Whenever all k faces have appeared, increment a completed-block count and clear the set.
Each completed block can supply one chosen symbol for every sequence position; after c blocks a carefully chosen next symbol is missing, proving the shortest impossible length c+1.
editorial: Each completed block can supply one chosen symbol for every sequence position; after c blocks a carefully chosen next symbol is missing, proving the shortest impossible length c+1.

tests.explanation: The rolls contain every one-symbol and two-symbol sequence as subsequences, but some length-three sequence is impossible.
Both faces occur, but sequence [2,1] is absent, so the answer is two.
